selection: Football = category 'Thể thao' + keyword regex on title/sapo. First 20000 eligible unique football articles of train-00001-of-00011-56cb80236db67400.parquet; 95/5 group split; train mixed 1:2 with general News train replay; val alternates football/general. Test = frozen football test1000 from the official test file.
